title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-133} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-27 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `12540856486358503759485869430182174501205661530906018358179595409/111933279712359705600000`, which is strictly greater than `2^{133}*(319/100) = 868400600382234958758531998165872475635712/25`.
- The degree-26 partial sum is strictly below that target, and the next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-133}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-133}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=7` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
- The parent commits are #4367, #4368, #4369, #4374 and #4379. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c7` and replays those predecessors.
